tips.title: Maximize Dining Spend
tips.content: Earn 1.5 Aeroplan points per dollar on dining and food delivery, making it a great category for frequent diners.

tips.title: Air Canada Purchases
tips.content: Get 2 Aeroplan points per dollar spent on Air Canada and Air Canada Vacations, ideal for frequent travelers.

tips.title: Preferred Pricing
tips.content: Use Aeroplan points for preferred pricing on Air Canada flights to maximize point value.

tips.title: Free Checked Bags
tips.content: Enjoy a free first checked bag for you and up to 8 companions on Air Canada flights, saving on baggage fees.

tips.title: Travel Insurance Coverage
tips.content: Includes coverage for flight delays and lost baggage, providing peace of mind during travels.

tips.title: High Interest Rate
tips.content: Avoid carrying a balance; the card has a 30% APR on unpaid balances, which can accumulate quickly.

tips.title: Combine with Other Cards
tips.content: Consider using this card alongside others for categories like groceries or gas to maximize overall points.
